ce884113c7ef.summary: Runs the AI enablement programme for DoorDash's marketing organisation: intake, office hours, training and documentation, plus a central view of every AI pilot and who owns it.
does: Run intake, prioritisation support, office hours and training for marketing teams adopting AI
Turn promising AI ideas into clear briefs, success metrics and repeatable workflows
Set light governance and lead AI education across the organisation
wants: 5+ years in enablement, learning and development, marketing operations, programme management or AI adoption
Experience across several marketing functions and comfort leading ambiguous, cross-team work

feed3290fc70.summary: The salary range for this role is $80,000 - $100,000, with annual bonus potential of up to $10,000.
does: Gift processing redesign. Assess a development team's gift entry and acknowledgment process in Raiser's Edge NXT, clean up the underlying data and configuration, and build automations that cut acknowledgment turnaround…
Organizational AI readiness. Assess how teams across an organization use (or avoid) AI, recommend a governance policy, and deliver a prioritized roadmap and staff training.
Program inquiry automation. Map how a program team handles incoming inquiries, deploy an AI tool to route requests and draft responses, and train staff to manage it.
Serve as a day-to-day contact for clients, and as primary contact in the Director's absence, building strong relationships with development teams, operations staff, and technical stakeholders.
Maintain work plans, timelines, and project dashboards, ensuring deliverables are met within scope, budget, and deadlines.
Attend client meetings and present deliverables, including assessment findings, process maps, and implementation updates.

The opportunity is real, but translating it into scalable commercialization frameworks, pricing strategies, and GTM plans requires specialized expertise and a dedicated strategy and planning leader. We're hiring a Director of AI Solutions Strategy & Planning to lead that work end-to-end. This role sits at the…
does: A comprehensive GTM strategy for Instacart's AI-driven solutions is defined and in motion — spanning consumer experiences, ecommerce analytics, and enhanced retailer workflows — with clear positioning, pricing…

Cross-functional alignment across Product, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Legal is established, with governance forums running smoothly and transparent decision-making processes embedded across GTM and product teams.

Pilot programs and experimentation frameworks are launched and producing real impact — validating AI-powered products with real retailer feedback and iterating based on measurable performance metrics.
Sales teams are enabled and equipped with AI-specific strategies, enablement materials, and training programs that accelerate adoption and pipeline velocity.

Market intelligence and competitive analysis are regularly informing product and commercialization decisions, keeping Instacart's AI solutions competitive, scalable, and aligned with evolving retailer needs.
